slices.focus: Journey's End adopts Nadia's intake model as the agency's standing frontline process after proven results.
slices.summary: After 3+ years of building, Nadia presents midyear numbers showing the agency serves roughly a third more newly arrived families while maintaining ~10-day first housing placement and keeping follow-up misses below the old norm. Leadership adopts her intake and follow-up model as the agency's standing frontline process. Nadia feels less braced for preventable failure. She plans to draft a one-page memo with results and conditions, then make one concrete ask for protected training time and documentation upkeep authority to prevent the adoption from becoming merely symbolic.
open_loops: Draft one-page memo summarizing results and conditions that produced them
Make one concrete ask: protected training time and documentation upkeep authority
Define success markers (quarterly training blocks, explicit revision ownership)
Preserve conditions that made the 30% capacity increase possible — don't let it become a squeeze
